experiment_id.principle: Traceability for the Exp5331 stable local internal-energy receipt harness.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Records the three mandated GGUF model IDs so the receipt harness cannot silently substitute a legacy, tiny, API, or non-GGUF model.
field_principles.backend_option_surface: Records the native backend help/API option surface used to decide whether logits, token probabilities, timing, attention, or hidden proxies are exposed.
field_principles.experiment_id: Traceability for the Exp5331 stable local internal-energy receipt harness.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete: or blocked_ and state whether a reproducible local non-text-score internal receipt exists.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares local_sota_internal_signal_receipt so the artifact is read as a stable local GGUF internal-receipt gate, not a generated-text quality scorer.
field_principles.milestone: Milestone accountability for the V486 internal receipt decision.
field_principles.missing_backend_features: Names unavailable backend features precisely so downstream internal-energy work does not substitute text scoring.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records Exp5324 stability, selected backend/model binding, GPU visibility, model cache status, and backend metadata/API option checks before any internal receipt claim.
field_principles.raw_output_receipt: Records prompt/output checksums and timing without interpreting generated text as answer quality.
field_principles.receipt_schema_path: Points to the tiny internal-receipt schema description, or to a blocked-schema description naming the missing backend feature precisely.
field_principles.selected_model_spec: Binds any internal receipt to the stable mandated model selected by Exp5324.
field_principles.status: Machine-readable terminal state for downstream internal-energy gates.
field_principles.tests_run: Commands run to validate the Exp5331 module, artifact schema, new-code coverage, and required repository test status.
field_principles.tiny_receipt_path: Points to the saved tiny non-text internal receipt when one exists; null when the runtime exposes only text or aggregate timing.
